name: CapCut
price: Free; Pro US$19.99/mo or US$179.99/yr (US pricing page)
watermark: No watermark on standard free 1080p exports; Pro assets add one
bestFor: Editors who stay on free templates and want CapCut's mobile-first workflow
notFor: Anyone who needs Pro templates, 4K/60fps, or a guaranteed watermark-free mobile export
limits: Free plan: basic editing and free templates. 4K and 60fps are locked on desktop. Pro assets (templates, effects, fonts, music, stickers, AI tools, premium transitions/LUTs) require Pro for a clean export. Mobile free length is around 15 minutes in some regions. Watermark policy: capcut.com/help/join-capcut-pro-for-exporting
